name: prompt-bouncer
description: Bounces vague prompts before Claude sees them, and suggests the project's own term

mode.title: Bouncer mode
mode.description: quick: instant rules, no model. project: a Haiku gate that checks the prompt against the project's docs.

docs.title: Project docs to read
docs.description: Comma-separated paths from the project root. A * matches file names inside one folder.

maxDocChars.title: Max characters of docs
maxDocChars.description: Docs past this size are cut, so the gate stays cheap.
